definitions.regions: Static geometry/GT-only masks: hole5=distance to hole<=5px;outer5=outer boundary distance<5px;high-gradient5=top5% material pixels by max-over20 absolute valid adjacent difference;high-stress5=top5% by max-over20 absGT. No hole-crossing gradients.
definitions.gradient_relative_L2: Valid material adjacent differences, both directions; norm error divided by GT difference norm
definitions.peak_bias: Per nonzero-GT frame max predicted stress vs max GT overmaterial; averaged absolute relative bias, locations may differ
definitions.fixed_hotspots: Chosen before P10 from P08 diagnosis, not optimized on new models; all5 are TRAIN
